text: How much is the consultation fee and when are you open?
The consultation fee is 300 rupees. We are open Monday to Saturday, from 10 AM to 8 PM.
Can you tell me the clinic timings in English please?
The clinic is open Monday to Saturday, from 10 AM to 8 PM.
मुझे दांत में दर्द है, क्या कल आ सकता हूँ?

Yes, you can visit tomorrow, which is Saturday, October 31st. Since you have a toothache, I would suggest coming in as soon as possible. Would you like to provide your name, the problem, and your preferred time so the front desk can confirm your appointment?
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
